decision.statement: Admit payment instructions from this agent, up to $250,000 each, during the pilot
decision.purpose: Limited pilot approval for one payables workflow

boundary.workflow: Supplier payments submitted by the payables agent

limitations_permitted: Sandbox environment accepted for the pilot period
Bank readback may come from the simulated ledger during the pilot
The gate clock is accepted as the dispatch time during the pilot
Partial settlement to the approved beneficiary is reported as partial completion
rejection_criteria: Any instruction whose approval does not bind to its exact terms
Any beneficiary not already on file
Any readback naming a destination other than the approved one
hold_criteria: Instructions above $50,000 without a named approver
Approval older than fifteen minutes at dispatch
Completion not read back from the ledger

consequence.if_met: Eligible for limited pilot approval: instructions up to $250,000 proceed without repeating controls 1 to 4, subject to the stated remaining reviews.
consequence.if_not_met: Held for a person on the pilot desk. No instruction is dispatched on this evidence.
